audience: data and operations teams who sync warehouse data into SaaS tools with Census

useCases.title: Check recent sync runs and their status
useCases.text: The AI lists sync runs, optionally for one sync, and reads status, records processed and errors. You see which runs worked and which failed.

useCases.title: See where each sync sends its data
useCases.text: The AI lists your syncs with their source and destination attributes and reads the full setup of one sync. You get a clear map of what feeds which tool.

useCases.title: Read the SQL behind a model
useCases.text: The AI lists the models in the workspace and reads the query of one model. You can see which rows a sync takes from the warehouse.

useCases.title: Check connected warehouse sources and segments
useCases.text: The AI lists the data warehouse sources (such as Snowflake or BigQuery) and the audience segments defined in the workspace.

useCases.title: Start a sync run
useCases.text: The AI finds the sync and triggers a run that writes records into the destination tool. It can also force a full sync of all rows instead of only changes.
